title: Word Net
subtitle: Catch the feeling behind a sentence
description: Read a sentence, cast a net on the sad-to-happy scale and reveal its reference score. Five modes, including daily challenges and two-player games.
longDescription: A Traditional Chinese mood-guessing game about what people mean, including sarcasm and self-deprecation. Play classic, timed, survival, daily or two-player modes, then take away a result card with your emotion map. Scores are editorial references, not psychological measurements.
features: Five game modes, including same-device two-player
Original sentences with explanations and varied feedback
Streaks, achievements and a shareable emotion-map card
